name: count-tabs
title: Count tabs
description: Tabs with a count by every label (Open 12, Closed 48): tabular figures, 99+ above a limit, a skeleton while loading, read out as 'Open, 12 items'.
docs: tabs is a list of { value, label, count, loading, disabled }. Control the selected tab with value and onValueChange, or leave them out and use defaultValue (the first tab by default); the panels are TabsContent from @rhs-ui/primitives/tabs, passed as children, or leave them out and show one list yourself. variant is line (an underline) or pill (a segmented control). Counts are written in tabular figures in the locale you pass and collapse to '99+' above max (99 by default). The accessible name of a tab is its label and its count, 'Open, 12 items' ('Open, 1 item', 'Shipped, more than 99 items'), so the number is read out with the tab; labels holds those words for another language. loading puts a small skeleton where the number goes and the name says 'loading count'. A tab with a count of zero dims but is not disabled, so the empty view stays reachable (use disabled to switch one off). Arrow keys, Home and End move and select, as in Tabs. When the count of the selected tab changes, one polite announcement says so ('Open, 13 items'); a count that changes in another tab, and the first render, say nothing. A row that is wider than its box scrolls sideways, with room inside the scroller for the focus ring. Without children there are no panels, so the tabs carry no aria-controls.
